label: Capture / update an inquiry
condition: Assigned commercial scope; not client acceptance.

label: Submit a proposal for review
condition: Current discovery/scope and separate pricing review.

label: Review commercial proposal
condition: Assigned commercial authority; never own prepared draft.

label: Collect factual intake evidence
condition: Only the assigned intake case; received is not verified.

label: Submit an intake case
condition: Complete required collection checks; checker must differ.

label: Record compliance disposition
condition: Assigned restricted case, evidence and rationale; not partner acceptance.

label: Accept / continue professional scope
condition: Current independent clearances, conditions and permissible service.

label: Assign work and deadlines
condition: Authorized engagement; valid existing team assignments.

label: Assign client request owner
condition: Only contacts already approved for the same entity.

label: Submit / replace requested evidence
condition: Assigned request and entity; no adequacy self-approval.

label: Accept technical request evidence
condition: Exact submission and authorized reviewer; no self-clearance.

label: Request evidence clarification
condition: Client-facing wording; internal conclusions stay private.

label: Read internal financial workspace
condition: Explicit client/engagement grant; no implicit group access.

label: Import a source trial balance
condition: Validated scope and schema; source snapshot, not source-ledger posting.

label: Prepare account mapping
condition: Draft revision only; preserve source account identity.

label: Approve technical account mapping
condition: Independent maker/checker and current source revision.

label: Propose reporting adjustment
condition: Balanced reporting proposal with evidence and scope.

label: Review reporting adjustment
condition: Not the preparer; evidence and exact proposed version.

label: Authorize management adjustment
condition: Verified signatory; technical review first; no firm-ledger posting.

label: Prepare workpaper / evidence
condition: Assigned procedure, recorded sources and conclusions.

label: Review submitted workpaper
condition: Independent and assigned; preserve exact submission.

label: Raise a professional review point
condition: Assigned review scope; severity and required action recorded.

label: Respond with revised evidence
condition: Responder cannot independently clear the response.

label: Clear first-level review point
condition: Issuer or documented qualified replacement; not responder.

label: Record manager completion
condition: Independent completion review; current package and gates.

label: Approve management accounts
condition: Exact presented package, verified signatory, reviewed version.

label: Authorize professional report
condition: Final evidence, management approval and all applicable quality gates.

label: Complete independent EQR
condition: Eligible non-team reviewer; significant concerns resolved; current package.

label: Issue the approved report package
condition: Exact frozen manifest and all mandatory gates; one issue event.

label: Dispatch authorized package
condition: Approved recipients/artifacts only; no content substitution.

label: Assemble completed file
condition: Authorized issued/delivered artifacts; no signed-content editing.

label: Record authorized hold instruction
condition: Instruction and scope required; no automatic hold release.

label: Request controlled disposition
condition: No active hold; expiry and separate approval remain required.

label: Nominate a client contact / role
condition: Existing entity only; signatory nomination requires firm verification.

label: Prepare firm invoice draft
condition: Office/firm ledger context; source, fees and scope required.

label: Review invoice / fee draft
condition: Separate commercial authority and independent reviewer.

label: Issue approved firm invoice
condition: Approved current commercial draft; not an audit release.

label: Record demo firm receipt
condition: Valid issued invoice; positive bounded allocation; separate bank verification.

label: Record own work time
condition: Own entry; approval must be independent.

label: Review staff time
condition: Assigned engagement and a different individual.

label: Process an approved access request
condition: Scope verification and approved authority; not self-granting professional power.

label: Prepare technical configuration change
condition: Approved configuration and separate change control; no live secrets in demo.

label: Decide annual continuance
condition: Current-period assessment, required clearances and authority.

label: Prepare authorized handover request
condition: Client-owned versus firm documents distinguished; recipient authority required.

label: Full prototype testing access
condition: Synthetic local demo identity only; business validation and client-facing information projections remain enforced.
